item.description: An artist's impression of Sunshine Station's forecourt at the northern side. item.title: KiwiRail almost triples half-year earnings
item.description: KiwiRail's total freight volumes rose 7 per cent to 1.8 billion net tonne kilometres in the first six months of FY26. Image: KiwiRail KiwiRail has welcomed some positive results in the first six months of the 2026 financial year, nearly tripling its earnings. The operator recorded an operating surplus of $73.4 million in H1 FY26 – up $47.6 million on the same period a year ago.
